title: Edgar Barrera & Jonas Cuaron On ‘Campeón Gabacho:’ Immigration, Music & Resilience | SXSW 2026
summary: Edgar Barrera & Jonas Cuaron sit down with Billboard Espanol’s Associate Editor, Isabela Raygoza, at SXSW 2026 to discuss their groundbreaking film ‘Campeón Gabacho,’ which tells a timely and powerful story about Mexican immigration through the lens of music, boxing, and resilience.
